source_access_definition: Underlying source reaccess means this writing agent inspected source content, sometimes only its public abstract/indexed excerpts. It does not mean independent human fact-checking, review of original archives, reproduction of laboratory work, or cover-to-cover reading of every full-text work.

passes.name: structural
actions: 34 different historical questions selected before drafting; 34 archival oral-history topic replaced with laboratory institutions to avoid Culture overlap.
Brewsters labor, inspectors resistance, fiscal governance, colonial voice and urban chicherias use distinct evidence questions.
Chapter 29 reframed from unsupported distribution inference to documented hand-soldered labor.

passes.name: fact_and_scope
actions: Checked important date/name/geography claims against original papers, publisher abstracts, institutional records and documentary transcripts.
Pilsen upgraded from inherited excerpt-only access to directly retrieved Rail PDF pages 20–23.
Abydos 2021/2022 dimensions differentiated; estimated capacity not narrated as actual output.
Kirikongo absence of direct residue/malting/intact brewery added explicitly.
Qasr Ibrim correctly located in Egyptian Nubia.
Direct-source access limits retained separately from wiki research status.

passes.name: cultural
actions: Cauim, giroba, chicha and pulque names preserved; pulque explicitly identified as agave-sap ferment, not cereal beer.
No pan-African ritual or global gender chronology; colonial source perspective distinguished from community voice.
Peoples labor/ownership distinction maintained without generalizing distillery evidence to beer.

passes.name: style
actions: Varied question, object, scene-free observation and puzzle openings.
Removed ambiguous use of dates as fruit in chapter 3.
Original explanations and implications accompany short attributed source facts; no reconstructed dialogue or extended quotation.

passes.name: reader_experience
actions: Cross-links connect Ninkasi/tablet, ancient crop/Bere and ice/Norway episodes.
Final laboratory chapter bridges into science while returning to opening hymn.
Notes average approximately 42 displayed words; complete access details kept in mapping.

passes.name: local_structure
actions: Heading/anchor sequence 001–034; one note marker and definition each; matrix titles synchronized.
Referenced wiki paths checked locally.

passes.name: cross_review_response
actions: Science agent read all 34 lessons/notes and identified no high- or medium-severity issue; this is AI cross-review, not outside expert peer review.
Chapter 22 corrected: malthouses managed steeping, germination and drying, not only post-germination grain.
Varied concluding transition cues in chapters 7, 9, 19, 22, 24 and 28.
Revalidated all 34 headings, note markers and definitions; revised prose totals 9059 words, lesson range 252–275.
